heading: Thursday, May 25, 2023
topLine: Deep learning screen finds narrow-spectrum antibiotic against Acinetobacter baumannii.

items.headline: Deep learning screen finds narrow-spectrum antibiotic against Acinetobacter baumannii
items.summary: McMaster and MIT researchers (Jonathan Stokes, James Collins) trained a neural network on a growth-inhibition screen of about 7,500 molecules and used it to pick abaucin, a compound active only against the WHO priority pathogen Acinetobacter baumannii via lipoprotein trafficking. Published in Nature Chemical Biology; abaucin controlled infection in a mouse wound model, so it is experimentally validated but preclinical.
